project.description: Job 3: build the PHP website image from the git repo's Dockerfile and deploy it on the test server. If it fails, a post-build task deletes the running container.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: SIMULATE_FAILURE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Fail on purpose after deploying, to test that the container is deleted on failure.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash # Job 3: build the PHP website image from the Dockerfile in the git repo and # deploy it as a container on the test server. Runs on the agent "test-server" # in a checkout of the repo's master branch. set -eu IMAGE=projcert-php CONTAINER=php-website PORT=8081 # 80 and 8080 are already used on this test server
docker build -t "$IMAGE:$BUILD_NUMBER" -t "$IMAGE:latest" .
# Replace the previous deployment docker rm -f "$CONTAINER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true docker run -d --name "$CONTAINER" --restart unless-stopped -p "$PORT:80" "$IMAGE:$BUILD_NUMBER"
# Smoke test: the home page must load and show the site's title for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -fs -o /dev/null "http://localhost:$PORT/" && break; sleep 1; done curl -fs "http://localhost:$PORT/" | grep -q "Simple PHP Website"
# Lets the failure path (Post-build Task) be demonstrated on demand if [ "${SIMULATE_FAILURE:-false}" = "true" ]; then echo "SIMULATE_FAILURE=true: failing on purpose to test the cleanup step" exit 1 fi
echo "Deployed build $BUILD_NUMBER: http://10.79.140.67:$PORT/"

hudson.plugins.postbuildtask.LogProperti.logText: Build step 'Execute shell' marked build as failure

hudson.plugins.postbuildtask.TaskPropert.script: #!/bin/bash # Task 4: if Job 3 fails, delete the running container on the test server. # Run by the Post-build Task plugin when Job 3's log shows a failed build step. echo "Job 3 failed: removing the php-website container from the test server" docker rm -f php-website || true
